summary: Completed second round testing of BookSlot multi-tenant SaaS booking platform. Backend ObjectId serialization issues are fixed - all 17 API tests pass. However, frontend form submission issues prevent user registration and login via UI, blocking full end-to-end testing.

ui_bugs.issue: Registration form validation prevents submission - name field shows 'Please fill out this field' even when filled
Login form submission not working - stays on login page after clicking sign in

integration_issues.issue: Frontend forms not submitting properly despite backend APIs working correctly

passed_tests: All 17 backend API endpoints working correctly
Landing page loads with hero section and proper navigation
Features and Pricing page navigation works
Login page loads with email/password form and Google login button
Signup page loads with registration form and Google signup button
AI receptionist widget appears on landing page
Public booking page structure exists with proper error handling
Protected routes correctly redirect to login when not authenticated
Tenant creation, staff/services/clients/appointments APIs all functional
Dashboard stats and reporting endpoints working
Public booking and AI receptionist API endpoints functional
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix frontend form submission issues: 1) Registration form validation preventing name field submission, 2) Login form not redirecting after successful authentication. Backend APIs are working correctly, issue is with frontend form handling/validation.
success_percentage: Backend: 100% (all APIs working), Frontend: 60% (UI loads correctly but forms don't submit)
